questions.question: Can you walk us through how you prepare monthly variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior-year results, including how you identify and communicate the underlying drivers?
Describe a complex account reconciliation you improved. What was unclear or inefficient about the prior process, what changes did you make, and what was the outcome?
This role supports budget development, forecasting, and scenario planning. What financial models or analyses have you built to explain account drivers or support management decisions?
Tell us about a time you identified a material operational processing inaccuracy affecting revenue or financial reporting. How did you investigate it, correct it, and prevent recurrence?
What has been your role in month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes, and how do you ensure account balances and journal entries are complete and accurate?
Describe your experience working with internal and external auditors. How have you prepared audit support, responded to findings, or resolved audit deficiencies?
How have you applied internal controls in your accounting work, including your experience eliminating or redesigning SOX controls while maintaining appropriate financial control?

This position requires partnership with program directors and non-finance staff. Can you give an example of how you presented financial results, metrics, or a new process to stakeholders with varying levels of financial knowledge?

You have experience with Oracle, Hyperion, and accounting-system implementations. Describe your role in the Oracle and commissions-system upgrade, including testing, mapping, validation, and resolution of issues.
What experience do you have with nonprofit accounting, including restricted funding, cost allocation, revenue recognition, Uniform Guidance, or OMB Circular requirements?
